assumptions: infinite 1D well, non-relativistic electron (energies ~ 22 eV << 511 keV)
single photon carries the whole transition energy

defect_reasons.other: TEDF7/T6BE7 ('was widened ... in an earlier experiment on it') do not say the widening was undone, so a reader could take the well as still 2.9 nm wide; the stated present width of 0.5 nm makes the D reading the consistent one, but the wording invites the other.

notes: With L = 2.9 nm: lambda = 8*511000*8.41/18600 = 1848.39 nm (scales as L^2: 54.946*(2.9/0.5)^2 = 54.946*33.64). Variants share 2.4 nm and differ in attachment/timing; numeral-free twins consistent. Quantum dot is a separate structure: D.
